theme: 3 terms on work when the app is not on screen: the capability setting, the short extra time, and the wake-up feature

terms.definition: A capability setting that lets your app keep working in the background, for example to play audio.
terms.example: Turn on Background Modes so the music keeps playing.

terms.definition: A short extra amount of time that iOS gives your app to finish work after the user leaves.
terms.example: Start a Background Task so the upload can finish.

terms.definition: A system feature that wakes your app now and then to fetch new data.
terms.example: Background Refresh keeps the feed fresh before the user opens the app.

quizzes.question: What do you call the system feature that wakes your app now and then to fetch new data?
What capability setting lets an app keep playing audio after the user leaves?
What do you call the short extra time iOS gives your app to finish saving after the user leaves?

video.title: Background Modes, Background Task & Background Refresh | Day 116
video.description:
Learn to explain how an iOS app can work in the background: Background Modes, Background Task & Background Refresh, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Background Modes - A capability setting that lets your app keep working in the background, for example to play audio.
Background Task - A short extra amount of time that iOS gives your app to finish work after the user leaves.
Background Refresh - A system feature that wakes your app now and then to fetch new data.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.hook: Can you explain Background Modes, Background Task and Background Refresh in English?

dialogue.title: Lost notes on exit

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, users lose notes when they leave the app during a save.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Ask for a Background Task, like in the code.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How long does that give us?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Only a short time. It is for finishing work, like `saveNotes`.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And I must call `endBackgroundTask` when I finish?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. If you forget, iOS ends the Background Task and stops your app.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That needs Background Refresh. iOS wakes the app when it decides.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No, only the earliest time. And enable the right Background Modes first.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Is Background Refresh one of the Background Modes?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, you will find it in the capabilities.
Enable Background Modes for audio playback.
